observations: body L1, L5: «جزء» (L1) and «المُرَبَّع» (L5) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L6: a short slanted stroke (1.7 by 1.1 points) is printed below the n of «al-Khāzinī»; not transcribed.
body L5, L7: «βαθμός» (L7) is printed with the closed theta θ, the star ϑ of L5 with the open one.
body L11, L12: the kasra under the r of the first «رِجْل» (L11) stands just above «قنطورس» (L12), which has no vowel signs; the second «رِجْل» of L11 has its kasra in the same place.
body L14: the sign = is printed as two bars 10.8 points long.
body L21: the first m of «المرْزَمُ» has no vowel sign; the sukūn of the r touches the fatḥa of the z (one piece, 5.6 by 3.5 points).
body L28: the hyphen of «ratio-» is printed short (2.6 points).
notes_left L3: the dash of «al–», where the name Ibn al-Athīr is broken between the columns, is an en dash (4.3 points); the hyphens of the footnotes measure 2.0-3.5 points on pp. 329-332.
notes_right L3: the superscript e of «3e» is printed filled, as a point.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
